name: CSR Parser
description: Parse a PKCS#10 certificate signing request: subject, public key, extensions and signature.

examples.label: Parse a CSR's subject, public key and signature

hints.challengePassword: The tool only reports whether a challenge password is present; it never echoes the value.
hints.safe: Read-only: the CSR is never modified and never written to disk.

faq.q: Will a CA honour the SANs in my CSR?
faq.a: Most CAs check them — do not put a domain in the CSR that does not match the subject.
A CSR has no validity period, but some CAs throttle repeated submissions.
The CSR's own signature verifies against the public key it carries, which means it was not tampered with.
